ops.title: Repair Forge cc-sudo CLI and privileged verifier version skew
ops.description:
Confirmed separate remote setup defect on yasyf@yasyf-forge: strict existing-known-host SSH inventory observed cc-sudo CLI0.12.2 (Caskroom0.12.2) versus root-owned verifier0.12.0; doctor explicitly failed version skew. Local requester/verifier0.13.0, remote authkit1.0.0 binary28c5 and already enrolled Forge selfkey459a match retained evidence. Synckit PID11709 was running with Studio+Home peers. Bounded diagnosis FE/cc-sudo-current-approver-readonly-diagnosis.json SHA1f43ff0143dca580d817a7d8e70260750a01eb7ad4feaf916f60c06919273938.

This skew is NOT proven cause of new756 trace approval exit104. fs_usage never ran. Presence/lock/protocol compatibility remain UNKNOWN. Third SSH detail/presence connection exited255 connect timeout before any remote command; do not blindly retry or repair while unavailable. Source shows routed signing is AuthKit through synckit, not inherently the remote cc-sudo verifier. Doctor/socket/mesh reachability is not live attendance proof.

Own supported forward-only genuine current matching CLI+verifier update with preservation of existing Secure-Enclave selfkey, peer trust, origin, known-host trust and sessions. Inspect exact installer euid/bootstrap and no raw sudo/compatibility code; scope only cc-sudo admin files and its supported helper staging. Official latest metadata currently v0.13.0 release426773556/public artifact54fafb09; no payload download/install/approval/globalCLI mutation is authorized in this preparation. Requalify genuine current version and existing state before a later real availability+Root grant. Missing approval availability is not permission to weaken trust or signal/restart.

Next: complete source-only bounded UNBOUND forward operator, preserving exact existing origin/keys/trust; independently review bootstrap. Execute only with genuine availability and explicit current grant. Acceptance requires matching genuine CLI/verifier, doctor0, and actual affected SSH/mesh approval proof, not source/static evidence alone. SDK consumer delivery retains priority.

ops.text: Independently review exact supported genuine-artifact forward update and privilege bootstrap; preserve existing self key, peer trust, origin, known hosts and sessions without raw sudo, compatibility code or unrelated admin changes.
On a later available authorized turn, install genuine current matching remote CLI and root-owned verifier and retain doctor exit0 with unchanged existing keys/trust/origin.
Prove the affected verified-SSH and mesh approval path actually succeeds with finite owned command evidence; distinguish presence/lock/transport/protocol and preserve original104/never-ran result.
